children: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VIII completed an IPO raising $287.5 million and placed $287.5 million in a U.S. trust account.
Sold 28,750,000 units at $10.00 each, including full 3,750,000 over-allotment, generating $287,500,000 gross proceeds.
Completed private placement of 8,000,000 warrants at $1.00 each, raising $8,000,000 (5M to Sponsor; 3M to Representative).
$287,500,000 of IPO and private placement proceeds (including up to $13.6875M deferred underwriting fee) held in U.S. trust account.
Audited balance sheet as of Aug 31, 2026 shows $287.5M cash in trust, $2.114M cash outside trust, total assets $289.655M.
Transaction costs totaled $19.545M (including $5.0M cash underwriting fee and $13.6875M deferred underwriting fee).
